law: Use the data in the notifications to update your user-account database, and to monitor and respond to in-app purchase refunds.
Use the notification type, along with the transaction and subscription renewal information, to update a customer’s service or to present promotional offers according to your business logic.
Use the token information to report it to Apple, including if you don’t recognize the token in your system.
Use the you receive to call the endpoint to learn how your server responds to the test notification.
